name: layer-purity
about: LAYER-PURITY LP6 pilot (project/archive/2026-10-03-layer-purity.md): an advisory check that an engine source file holds no game or content knowledge, for what the word-list lint (wildshard/engine-words) cannot see — a shard's data under generic names, a game's theme, one level's AI. Scored on a labelled set from the E405 moves (scripts/decide/layer-purity-pilot.mjs). Not a gate.

content.instructions: This is a source file from the ENGINE layer of a game codebase. The engine must be generic: rendering, physics, input, audio playback, boot, UI frameworks, and data structures any game could use. Does this file instead contain knowledge of a particular game's content — named creatures, items, weapons, places, levels, characters, quests, a specific soundtrack or tuned values and tables for specific content — rather than only generic mechanisms that receive such content as data?

calibrated.result: threshold 0.5: 7/12 content caught, 0/12 false alarms; threshold 0.3: 9/12, 0/12; AUC ~0.93. Caught all three the word-list lint missed (Pine's NightBrain 0.59, Pine's tree set 0.82, the theme 0.72). Missed gen.ts, HurtArc and the pickup models (content past the 13k-character cut or explicit words the hard rule catches). ~1.6 s a file, lock free.
